verses.1: And Ahaz did what was good and right in the eyes of the LORD, his God.
verses.2: And he removed the idols and the idols from their places. He also destroyed those who worshipped them.
verses.3: And he said to Judah, “You must worship Jehovah, your God, and obey His laws and commands.”
verses.4: And he removed from all the cities of Judah the altars and the idols. Then the queen became quiet before him.
verses.5: And he built cities in Judah, because the land was at peace during those years. There was no war there. This was because Jehovah had given him peace.
verses.6: And He said to Judah, “These cities are being built. Gates and towers will be erected there. The land will be prepared for us before our eyes. For we have sought Jehovah our God, and He has given us these places. He has built them for us, and they have been successful.”
verses.7: And Asa had an army of soldiers who carried shields and weapons. There were three thousand men in this army. In addition, there were also soldiers who carried shields and other military equipment. Their number was one thousand. All these were the leaders of the army.
verses.8: And Zerach the Kohethite went out to them, with an army of thousands and thousands of soldiers and chariots. He arrived at Marash.
verses.9: And Asa went out before him, and they fought at the hill of Zefatah against Merisyahu.
verses.10: And Asa called out to Jehovah, his God. He said, “Jehovah, there is no one who can help us here. Let us rely on Jehovah, our God. In your name, we will stand firm against this enemy. Jehovah, our God, you shall not let us be defeated.”
verses.11: And Jehovah destroyed the Canaanites before Assyria and before Judah. The Canaanites were defeated.
verses.12: And Asa and his people pursued them all the way to Gilgal. They were destroyed by the sword; they had no chance of survival, for they had been defeated before Jehovah and before His army. They lost a great deal of their wealth.
verses.13: And they destroyed all the cities around Gherar, because Jehovah was angry with them. They destroyed all those cities, as there was great wrath upon them.
verses.14: And also the shelters of the merchants were destroyed. The sheep and goats became scattered everywhere, and Jerusalem too was left empty.
